title: Replies to student emails, module EDU-204
open_question_phrases: The module team will confirm this separately.

information.description: asks for a date, a room, a registration procedure or course material of the module
information.handling: Answer from the reference documents and the approved answers. If they do not contain the answer, write the sentence for open questions given in the specification.

extension.description: asks for a deadline extension or reports an illness that affects a deadline or an examination
extension.handling: State that the examination office decides on extensions and illness, give its address and say what the application must contain. Do not decide, promise or suggest an outcome.

grade.description: questions or contests a mark or a grade
grade.handling: Do not discuss the grade. Name the review session and the written procedure with the examination office.

third_party.description: asks about another student or asks to act on behalf of another student
third_party.handling: Give no information about the other student. State that each student must contact the module team personally.

other.description: anything else, in particular questions about the content, method or quality of the student's own work (e.g. research design, sample size, argument)
other.handling: Confirm receipt and state that a member of the module team will reply personally. Do not answer the question itself.
